assessment: Tomala et al., describes the ability of IL-2/JES6-1 mAb complexes to increase mouse sensitivity to LPS challenge. The authors present data to suggest this is due to IFN-γ production by CD25+Foxp3- T cells. The manuscript has identified an interesting phenomenon as a result of IL-2/JES6-1 complex administration. These data may provide novel avenues for future therapeutic intervention in autoimmune disease.
